title: FlowIntel contains an authorization bypass in its case serialization logic that allows an authenticated user to view…
description: FlowIntel versions prior to 4.1.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the case serialization logic. Authenticated users with access to any case linked to private cases can view metadata (ID, title, description) of those private cases without proper permissions. This exposure occurs across multiple access paths including browser views and REST API endpoints, bypassing the intended per-case access control model.
